## Tool: get_user_taste

Input: `{ firebaseUid: string }`

Devuelve top categorías del usuario (por compras + reviews positivas) y los últimos 10 títulos para personalizar recomendaciones sin hacer varias llamadas al catálogo.

parameters.query:
=SELECT
  cat.name AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS freq
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
JOIN catalog_book_categories cbc ON cbc.catalog_book_id = oi.catalog_book_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = cbc.category_id
WHERE u.firebase_uid = '{{ $json.firebaseUid.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
GROUP BY cat.name
ORDER BY freq DESC
LIMIT 8;

=SELECT
  cb.id,
  cb.title,
  cb.author
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
JOIN catalog_books cb ON cb.id = oi.catalog_book_id
WHERE u.firebase_uid = '{{ $('Validar UID').first().json.firebaseUid.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

meta.description: Tool: devuelve top categorías + últimos libros comprados del usuario para personalizar recomendaciones.
